meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会自己启动浏览器操作网页:打开链接、点击、填表、截图、抓数据;页面状态在多次脚本之间保持,可边做边看结果再决定下一步。
howto.when: 当你要它打开某个网址、填表、截图等任意浏览器交互请求时触发;已登录站点可用扩展模式接管你现有的 Chrome。

say.text: 打开 example.com,告诉我页面标题和地址
say.note: 会启动浏览器并返回标题、网址

say.text: 在这个页面上填写登录表单并提交
say.note: 脚本会定位输入框并点击提交

say.text: 截一张整页截图存到 tmp 下
say.note: 生成 fullPage 截图文件

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives a browser itself: opening links, clicking, filling forms, taking screenshots, scraping data. Page state persists across script runs, so it can check results and decide the next step.
howto.when_en: Triggered by any browser interaction request, e.g. opening a URL, filling a form, taking a screenshot. Extension mode can attach to your existing logged-in Chrome.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me the page title and URL
say_en.note: Launches browser, returns title and URL

say_en.text: Fill in the login form on this page and submit it
say_en.note: Scripts locate fields and click submit

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot into tmp/
